intro.sr: Paketi nemaju samostalnu naplatu na sajtu - administrator ručno dodeljuje paket klijentu, a klijent zatim iz njega troši seanse kroz običan tok zakazivanja, bez ikakve doplate.
intro.en: Packages have no self-checkout - an admin manually assigns one to a customer, who then spends sessions from it through the ordinary booking flow, at no extra charge.

registracija.sr: Klijent se prvo registruje - nalog mora da postoji da bi administrator mogao da mu dodeli paket.
registracija.en: The customer registers first - an account has to exist before an admin can assign them a package.

prijava.sr: Klijent se prijavljuje na svoj novi nalog.
prijava.en: The customer logs into their new account.

admin-prijava.sr: Administrator se prijavljuje da bi dodelio paket klijentu.
admin-prijava.en: The admin logs in to assign a package to the customer.

admin-ulazak-otvara-nalog-meni.sr: Administrator klikne na dropdown sa svojim imenom u gornjem desnom uglu.
admin-ulazak-otvara-nalog-meni.en: The admin clicks the dropdown showing their name in the top-right corner.

admin-ulazak-otvara-admin-panel.sr: Administrator bira „Admin panel” iz menija, čime se otvara admin deo sajta.
admin-ulazak-otvara-admin-panel.en: The admin picks "Admin panel" from the menu, opening the site's admin area.

admin-paketi-otvara-meni.sr: Administrator klikne na grupu „Katalog” u admin meniju.
admin-paketi-otvara-meni.en: The admin clicks the "Catalog" group in the admin menu.

admin-paketi-bira-stavku.en: The admin picks "Purchased packages" from the menu.

admin-paketi-klik-na-dodaj.sr: Administrator klikne „Dodeli paket”, čime se otvara forma za dodelu.
admin-paketi-klik-na-dodaj.en: The admin clicks "Assign package", opening the assignment form.

admin-dodeljuje-paket.sr: Administrator potvrđuje dodelu - paket od 3 seanse je sada na klijentovom nalogu, spreman za korišćenje.
admin-dodeljuje-paket.en: The admin confirms the assignment - a 3-session package is now on the customer's account, ready to use.

otvaranje-stranice-usluge.sr: Klijent otvara stranicu usluge za koju ima paket i bira varijantu.
otvaranje-stranice-usluge.en: The customer opens the page for the service their package covers and selects a variant.

izbor-datuma-i-termina.sr: Klijent bira datum i slobodan termin, isto kao kod obične kupovine.
izbor-datuma-i-termina.en: The customer picks a date and an available slot, same as an ordinary booking.

placanje-iz-paketa.sr: Sistem prepoznaje da klijent ima upotrebljiv paket za baš ovu uslugu - opcija „plati iz paketa” je automatski čekirana, sa brojem preostalih seansi.
placanje-iz-paketa.en: The system recognizes the customer has a usable package for this exact service - the "pay from package" option is checked automatically, showing how many sessions remain.

unos-kontakt-podataka.sr: Klijent unosi broj telefona pre potvrde.
unos-kontakt-podataka.en: The customer enters a phone number before confirming.

potvrda-zakazivanja.sr: Termin je zakazan bez ikakve naplate - cena je pokrivena paketom.
potvrda-zakazivanja.en: The appointment is booked with no charge at all - the price is covered by the package.

admin-termini-otvara-meni.sr: Administrator klikne na grupu „Zakazivanje” u admin meniju.
admin-termini-otvara-meni.en: The admin clicks the "Scheduling" group in the admin menu.

admin-termini-bira-stavku.en: The admin picks "Appointments" from the menu.

admin-termini-pretraga.sr: Administrator pretražuje listu po email adresi klijenta.
admin-termini-pretraga.en: The admin searches the list by the customer's email.

admin-termini-otvaranje-rezultata.sr: Administrator otvara novi termin iz rezultata pretrage.
admin-termini-otvaranje-rezultata.en: The admin opens the new appointment from the search results.

admin-potvrdjuje-termin.sr: Administrator potvrđuje termin - seansa je sada rezervisana iz paketa, ali još nije potrošena.
admin-potvrdjuje-termin.en: The admin confirms the appointment - the session is now reserved from the package, but not yet spent.

admin-zavrsava-termin.sr: Kada je usluga zaista pružena, administrator označava termin kao završen - tek sada se seansa iz paketa stvarno troši.
admin-zavrsava-termin.en: Once the service has actually been delivered, the admin marks it completed - only now is the session from the package actually spent.
